select count(*) > 0 from information_schema.tables where lower(table_name) = 't_usr_interest' and lower(table_schema) = lower(schema())
mapper.sql:
union all select s.ims_id as source_id, 'HR' as category, 'HR' as thread_type, s.ims_id as thread_id, concat(coalesce(c.cmp_name, '企业'), ' HR · ', coalesce(nullif(hr.nick_name, ''), hr.user_name)) as thread_title, '' as title, coalesce(nullif(s.ims_last_message, ''), '暂无消息内容') as content, coalesce(s.ims_last_message_at, s.ims_updated_at, s.ims_created_at) as occurred_at, coalesce(s.ims_unread_b, 0) as unread_count, 1 as event_count, hr.avatar as avatar_url, null as target_url, null as badge from t_im_session s join sys_user hr on hr.user_id = s.ims_user_a_id and hr.del_flag = '0' left join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = (select min(b.bnd_company_id) from t_cmp_binding b where b.bnd_user_id = hr.user_id and b.bnd_status = 1) where s.ims_user_b_id = #{userId}
union all select i.int_id as source_id, 'COMPANY' as category, 'COMPANY' as thread_type, c.cmp_id as thread_id, concat(c.cmp_name, ' · 企业动态') as thread_title, '' as title, '已关注，暂无新动态' as content, coalesce(i.int_updated_at, i.int_created_at) as occurred_at, 0 as unread_count, 0 as event_count, c.cmp_logo_url as avatar_url, concat('/companies/', c.cmp_id) as target_url, '关注' as badge from t_usr_interest i join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = i.int_target_id and c.cmp_status = 1 where i.int_user_id = #{userId} and i.int_target_type = 2 and i.int_status = 1 and not exists (select 1 from t_msg cm where cm.msg_receiver_id = #{userId} and cm.msg_type = 4 and cm.msg_target_url like concat('/companies/', c.cmp_id, '?positionId=%'))
mapper.select: select category, sum(unread_count) as unread_count from () e group by category
